messages:
tariq: DeployBot alerted on eu-west1 canary: sudden p50 jump ~3.5x and a handful of 502s. tagging @ops_miguel @celia for an expedited call.

celia: I see it. traces look like increased serialization time on a small subset after the release. Can we pin region or do targeted rollback? What's fastest with least risk to traffic?

ops_miguel: pin is fastest and keeps majority of fleet untouched. rollback is heavy and will cause route churn. Need decision in 8m because canary window is failing.

deploybot: Canary metrics -> failures=5, p50-ms=360 -> threshold-exceeded. Suggested actions: `pin-region` or `rollback-release`. Use `/deploy expedite` to confirm.

pm_rachel: FYI release notes already published. If we revert we should add a short note and flag customer comms if it becomes a wider rollback.

tariq: quick check: artifact SHA looks identical across regions. This smells infra-ish. My vote: pin eu-west1 to previous image `redwood/serve:2026.03.04-stable` and run an elevated canary for 30m.

celia: +1. QA saw no semantic diffs. I'll prepare release-note blurb.

ops_miguel: executing pin now:
`/deploy pin --region eu-west1 --image redwood/serve:2026.03.04-stable --reason "expedite-pin due to canary serialization latency" --approver ops_miguel`

releasebot: Pin accepted and queued. Rolling pin across eu-west1 (expected ~3m). Notifying on-call and release owners.

infra_bot: Added context: auto-kernel rollout completed this morning on subset of hosts. Correlating host IDs with spikes. Filing INFRA-4551.

deploybot: Pin progress: 9/9 nodes pinned. Health checks: passing. Telemetry: p50 back to baseline within 75s. Error-rate reduced to 0.05%.

celia: pushing release-note quick patch: "Temporarily reverted platform kernel/image change in eu-west1 after canary latency increase; investigation ongoing." PR -> https://git.internal/docs/changes/PR-1023

pm_rachel: nice. I'll schedule a short customer notice draft in case rolling back globally becomes necessary.

tariq: good work. Leaving elevated monitoring for 24h and a 2h follow-up triage with infra. Please attach traces/host-ids to INFRA-4551.

ops_miguel: INFRA-4551 created with traces and repro script. Linking here.

releasebot: Release-note PR merged. Changelog updated.

celia: running a 10m synthetic against pinned nodes at 3qps to validate. Posting results in ~9m.

deploybot: Canary sensitivity set to high for 24h for eu-west1. Auto-rollback disabled during investigation.

celia: synthetic looks stable, no additional 5xxs and p50 steady. Closing expedited approval but will reopen if alerts reappear.

ops_miguel: marking thread resolved for now. Follow-ups: INFRA-4551 triage in 2h, customer comms draft ready. Thanks team :thumbsup:
